name: pr-review-dashboard
description: Builds a section-by-section self-review dashboard for a pull request or a stack of them, and acts on the notes you leave on it

github_client_id.title: GitHub OAuth app client id
github_client_id.description: Optional. Client id of a GitHub OAuth app you register, with device flow enabled, that guests sign in with when you share a review. Without it guests type a name, which nothing checks, and you check a code with them before letting them in.

allowed_mail.title: Emails allowed into a shared review
allowed_mail.description: Optional comma-separated list, such as alice@acme.com,*@acme.com. Cloudflare then asks guests for an email one-time PIN before the page loads. Leave it empty for now: Cloudflare's session lapses soon after the PIN and guests get stuck.
